content_sections.heading: MyGov Content Writer Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be responsible for the following roles and responsibilities: Maintain up-to-date knowledge of all government schemes, policies, and decisions, and understand their historical and cross-sectoral contexts. Ideate, plan, and write authentic, well-researched content for tweets, infographics, and long-form and short-form videos across all social media platforms. Utilize strong data analysis and interpretation skills to extract meaningful insights and trends from various sources. Create visual aids such as charts, diagrams, infographics, creatives, and videos to communicate complex data effectively and engagingly. Demonstrate excellent writing skills to create compelling and accurate contents, articles, and other written materials. Implement best SEO practices and understand social media metrics (traffic, engagement, conversion rates). Maintain strict standards for fact-checking and writing – we are a zero-false information, zero-grammatical error organization.
